🐾 600+ Dogs Rescued | Saving Dogs from High-Kill Shelters Every Day. DONATE 👇👇 to Give a Dog a Second Chance ❤️

We are a foster-based, volunteer-run rescue helping abandoned, neglected, and abused dogs.

❤️ Help save lives:
• Adopt
• Foster
• Donate
• Subscribe & share

Every donation matters:
🐶 $5 – Feeds a hungry dog
💉 $10 – Antibiotics & wound care
🚐 $25 – Transport & parasite treatment
🏥 $50 – Emergency vet care
❤️ $100 – Ongoing medical care
🩸 $200 – Advanced treatment
🚑 $300 – Hospitalization
🦴 $400 – Emergency surgery
🐾 $500 – Can completely save a life

We have no corporate sponsors—every rescue depends on your support.

🙏 Thank you for standing with us and giving these dogs the future they deserve.

📍 8464 Beach Blvd, Jacksonville, FL 32216, USA

zamoraanimalrescue@gmail.com
